Cineplex has appointed Bill Walker as chief executive officer to review strategic alternatives for the company's future, including a potential sale.

Cineplex is evaluating opportunities to enhance and maximize value for all shareholders and will consider a range of alternatives, including, but not limited to, a potential sale of the company, it said.
Walker has previously served as CEO of Landmark Cinemas, Canada's second-largest theater exhibitor, operating as part of Kinepolis Group NV, a publicly traded cinema company based in Belgium.
He will take over the position immediately, replacing Ellis Jacob, who is retiring from the position. Jacob will serve as special advisor to the board through December 31, 2026.

title: Cineplex names Bill Walker as CEO and launches strategic review including potential sale
